name: DCA Lamplight Lounge Warm Cinnamon-Sugar Donuts with Chocolate Dipping Sauce
whyItWorks: Warm, pillowy fried cake donuts rolled in cinnamon sugar, served with chocolate and seasonal berry dipping sauces. Completely seed-free when dipped in chocolate sauce.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Warm Donuts; dip exclusively in the chocolate sauce (pass on the seeded berry sauce).
watchOuts: Dip in chocolate sauce; avoid the seasonal berry sauce containing fruit seeds
